PaymentDate.name: Payment Date
PaymentDate.definition: Date/time at which the distribution is due to take place (cash and/or securities).

AvailableDate.name: Available Date
AvailableDate.definition: Date/time at which securities become available for sale.

DividendRankingDate.name: Dividend Ranking Date
DividendRankingDate.definition: Date/time at which a security will be entitled to a dividend.

PariPassuDate.name: Pari Passu Date
PariPassuDate.definition: Date on which security will assimilate, become fungible, or have the same rights to dividends as the parent issue.

FirstDealingDate.name: First Dealing Date
FirstDealingDate.definition: Date/time at which new securities begin trading.

EarliestPaymentDate.name: Earliest Payment Date
EarliestPaymentDate.definition: Date/time at which a payment can be made, eg, if payment date is a non-business day or to indicate the first payment date of an offer.
